senses.gloss:
शृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Boiled, (water, milk or Ghee.)
 E. श्रा to boil, aff. क्त,
form irr.; or शृ-क्त; as applied to any other substances, the form
is श्राण or श्रपित ।

सृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone.
 E. सृ to go, aff. क्त ।

सृति f. (-तिः)
 1. A road, a path, a way.
 2. Going, gliding, proceeding.
3. Hurting, injuring.
 E. सृ to go, aff. क्तिन् ।

सृत्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Going, moving.
 f. (-री)
 1. A stream, a river.
 2. A
mother.
 E. सृ to go, क्वरप् aff., तुक् augment.
